description: Inspect retained county assessments and, where the supported evidence model permits, a draft building-assessment-equity comparison. Separate conditional rate scenarios from unavailable personal savings. Preserve unsupported building/classification, yard-item, source-conflict and unknown-year/rate holds. This tool does not certify market value, benefits, filing or payment readiness.

actual_sqft.description: Optional: Actual measured living area in sq ft (to detect assessor CAMA square footage measurement errors)

address.description: Alternative alias for property street address

address_or_pidn.description: Full street address or county parcel ID (e.g. '3731 Anderson Ave, Chattanooga, TN' or '157I L 001')

county_key.description: Optional exact registered county adapter key, such as hamilton. Restricts lookup to that county and avoids unrelated county scans; conflicting explicit prefixes are rejected.

notice_appraised_value.description: Optional: New proposed appraised value from reassessment notice (if differing from current online county roll)

name: audit_property_tax
